You will see its face among your faces and its work in your trend. Until one is connected, this card promises the shape — and shows no invented activity.

A payment link on your page takes the money through Stripe — connected with its own sign-in, once, and only with your permission. Every payment is written into the same activity these blocks read: this front says “you made X from Y”, each payment is filed on the person who paid, and a payment that fails becomes a kind drafted recovery message in your Growth room — never a silent loss. Until payments are connected, this card shows no numbers at all.

Smart Skills

The skills so far — the list keeps growing. Every skill is a capability you call on by name: a Smart Note (the knowledge) + a Factory template (the ability to do it), stored in your Smart Box. Tap a skill to see why it matters.

✦ The Login Skill

One dial, your name, your code — and you're in. The door into NayaNET.

The login is the first thing anyone ever touches. If it feels like a form, the whole system feels like a form. If it feels like stepping through a portal into a private world, the whole system feels like a place worth entering. The door sets the feeling for everything after it.

✦ The Mail Skill

Your mail and your messages in one place, private by default — nobody reads them, not even us.

The old internet spied on your mail. Every message you sent was read, scanned, and sold. Here it is the opposite: your mail is yours, and it stays yours. When people know nobody is listening, they talk freely — and that is when real connection happens.

✦ The Notes Skill

I take your notes and turn what you learn into intelligence everyone can use.

A good idea that isn't written down is gone by tomorrow. And an idea that is written down but never shared only helps one person. When I take the note and share the good ones, your learning doesn't die with the day — it compounds, and everyone gets smarter from it.

✦ The Lists Skill

Your people and your notes, organized, one tap away.

The old internet made you hunt. Your contacts were in one app, your notes in another, and the thing you were looking for was always in the third place you checked. When your world is organized for you, you stop hunting and start doing.

✦ The Links Skill

Every link you share is clean, short, and tracked — you see the click and the return.

A raw link is a mess — long, ugly, and silent. You share it and you never know if anyone came. A clean link is an address someone can remember, and the tracking means you know it worked. Sharing without knowing is shouting into the dark; sharing with a Smart Link is a conversation.

✦ The Meet Skill

Meet face to face, right inside your world, whenever you book it.

A meeting that makes you leave your world breaks your flow. You were in your page, with your notes and your people, and then you had to go somewhere else to talk. When the meeting lives where your world lives, the conversation starts where you left off — with everything you need right there.

✦ The Factory Skill

Tell me what you want to build, and I build it from the parts that already exist.

You should not need design skill to have a beautiful world. The old way said: learn to design, or hire someone who can. The factory says: the taste is locked into the template. You bring the idea, I bring the parts, and the result is beautiful from the first click — because the parts were already made beautiful by someone who knows how.

✦ The Match Skill

I find the people like you, automatically, and show you how close the match is.

The old internet showed you strangers and called it connection. You had to hunt for your people, and most of the time you never found them. When the system knows who you are, it can bring your people to you — and that is the difference between a feed full of noise and a world full of like minds.

✦ The Box Skill

Your own private box that remembers everything for you and keeps it organized.

There is a sickness in the old internet: you save things and you never find them again. The note is in one app, the file in another, the lesson in a third — and when you need it, it is gone. The box cures that. Everything you save goes to one place, and one place is the only place you ever have to look.

✦ The Numbers Skill

Everything you do is recorded, and your numbers are shown back to you as gauges you can read in two seconds.

If you can't see your numbers, you can't see your world. How many points have you earned? How many people joined through you? How is your world doing? Without the record, you are guessing. With it, you know — and knowing is what lets you decide what to do next.

✦ The Access Skill

Turn any page into a membership — your course, your lessons, your people, behind a door that fits.

Your teaching should live in your world, not in a separate app. The old way said: build a course somewhere else, send people away from your page, and hope they come back. Here the course IS your page — the same cover, the same feed, the same login. Your people never leave your world to learn from you.

✦ The Ask Skill

Ask me anything, and I answer from everything the system knows.

Intelligence is only useful if you can ask for it. A library nobody asks is a locked room. A system that knows everything but answers nothing is a machine with no door. Asking is the door — it is how the intelligence gets from the system to you, in the moment you need it.

✦ The Growth Skill

Invite people to your world, watch them join, and earn half of what they pay, automatically.

The people who love a place are the ones who bring the next people. The old internet took that gift and gave nothing back — you brought your friends, and the company kept the money. Here it is the opposite: the citizens grow the network, so the citizens earn from it. That is how a network becomes a community instead of a company.

✦ The Reports Skill

Every day, I look back on what you did, learned, and noted, and give you the day in a nutshell.

A day you don't look back on is a day you don't learn from. You did things, you learned things, you met people — and by tomorrow, most of it is gone, because nobody wrote it down. The report writes it down for you. It is how a life becomes a story you can read, instead of a blur you can barely remember.

✦ My Smart Link

A Smart Link is your own short NayaNET address — nayanet.app/your-name — that sends people to any link you choose and counts every click on the way through. Paste any link you want tracked — a video, a product page, your ambassador link — claim a name, then share the short address everywhere. Every click is counted, and when someone who arrived through it joins NayaNET, that join is credited to your link too. You choose where it sends people, and NayaNET never changes that. Pick your name carefully — a claimed name can’t be renamed later.

One short address for everything you share — and every click on it, counted. Paste the link you share today, pick the name you want instead, and your short link is live — with every click on it counted.

Ambassador payouts land every Wednesday, after the trial period — no holdbacks.

Reading your Smart Links…
Your short address will be nayanet.app/ + the name you pick. Start typing — we’ll tell you right away if it’s free.

✦ Cover buttons — your memberships

The buttons at the top corner of your cover, where visitors always see them — so they always see where to join. Smart marketing: your profile is a landing page. Each button has its own on/off — if you don’t want to promote a membership, turn it off. A button wakes up when you enter its URL — it takes the next empty spot, up to five. They are meant for memberships, but any URL works: a social site of yours can sit here too. Generic links belong in the Smart Bar.
